note: Set price_per_million_input/output from your provider's CURRENT pricing - prices change often, so verify before trusting the cost column. Add or remove rows to compare only the models you can actually run on your key. Leave a price at 0 to compare on pass rate and tokens alone; set both to rank by cost per outcome. The judge block is only needed if your cases use judge-type checks; it names the model that scores those checks (judge calls are not counted in the cost columns).
